name: C01 ID visual source readiness rubric
purpose: Evaluate whether C01 has transformed C00 visual/human-interface intent into a Rockbox-style ID package that a human designer and downstream teams can use.

readiness_states.missing: No source artifact or usable requirement exists.
readiness_states.drafted: AI-created source exists but human/ID approval is pending.
readiness_states.blocked: A visual/interface decision blocks useful ID output.
readiness_states.accepted-risk: User approved proceeding with a documented visual or constraint gap.

ready_when: at least one visual form archetype is selected or drafted
primary faces and user-facing component zones are represented
visible component callouts are present for all C00/C03 exposed interfaces
unresolved proportions/placement choices are labeled
visual tone and brand mood are drafted or answered
color/material/finish candidates are listed
environment/use-case rationale is linked back to C00
supplier/sample/approval gaps remain explicit
display/status model is present or explicitly not applicable
screen or LED states map to C00/C05 functional behavior
interaction states and firmware-facing labels are visible
UI style approval status is explicit
exposed components are enumerated
preferred faces/zones and keepouts are machine-readable
constraints identify downstream target layers C02/C03/C04
conflicts and decision owners are explicit
C00-derived visual intent is summarized
AI drafts and human/external decisions are separated
open issues and blockers are listed
handoff owner/reviewer is identified or marked missing

scoring_policy.rule: C01 is usable when the three Rockbox target deliverables (Ai file, CMF, Display UI/UX) exist at least as drafts, supporting bridge/handoff artifacts exist, and every downstream conflict has an owner, state, and visible risk label.
